finalText:
All objectives completed. Final report:

1. **DONE** — Ticket created with title `rgrd1jev-n1 RD Bench Ticket`, reference **RD-1021** (detail route `/#/tickets/t15`), customer "Blue Fox Cafe", initial status **Draft**. Only field required by the create form was Title (Customer optional).

2. **DONE** — Part `rgrd1jev-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (parts total $125.00).

3. **DONE** — Part `rgrd1jev-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total $375.00).

4. **DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

5. **DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app refused the first "Mark Ready" attempt with the alert *"Ticket is not ready — Part "rgrd1jev-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "rgrd1jev-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. I satisfied it by editing each part and setting Supplier = "Acme Bearings" (Part A) and "Bolt & Nut Supplies" (Part B); "Mark Ready" then succeeded and the page showed Status **Ready** (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").

6. **DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via the row's Delete button, confirmed through the in-app "Confirm" dialog with "Delete part"); parts region then showed the empty state **"No parts on this ticket yet."** with no part rows and no total row. Ticket archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog; button flipped to "Unarchive ticket"), header showing Status **Ready** plus an **Archived** badge. Active tickets list dropped from 14 to **13** rows with no RD-1021 present; with "Show archived" enabled the row `RD-1021 | rgrd1jev-n1 RD Bench Ticket | Archived | Blue Fox Cafe | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-20` appears. Nothing created by this run remains active.
